title: Terrain shade patches render as hard-edged rectangles: grass, sand and highland rock look like a quilt of tile seams
steps: Open /game/games/mad-maze/index.html?mode=world&test=1&seed=12345 at 1280x720
Walk around the Shore grass near tile 50,106 (tent camp), or any big grass/sand/highland area
Look at the ground away from terrain borders
expected: Soft variation inside one terrain type: no visible tile grid, no rectangles
actual: The seeded per-tile shade patches are flat, hard-edged 1-4 tile rectangles that are a bit lighter or darker than the base colour. On large grass, sand and highland areas they read as a patchwork of square seams. Single dirt tiles scattered around the camp add more noise. The ground looks blocky rather than textured.
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/realm-world.js:305 (tileDetail baked into the chunk canvas, ?tiledetail=0 = flat)

title: Godlands (Lethal, top zone) looks almost the same as the Highlands: grey on grey, no visual cue for the deadliest zone
steps: seed=12345, stand at tile 118,111 (Godlands) and then at 121,92 (Highlands)
Compare the screenshots
expected: The end-game zone has its own clear look (ash, darker tone, glow), so the player knows they crossed into Lethal ground without reading the HUD
actual: godland_ash and highland_rock are both mid-grey, with the same shade-patch rectangles and the same props (pines, dead trees, rocks). The only clear difference is the small red blood_ruins block. The HUD line is the only reliable cue that you are in Godlands.

title: Terrain edges mix three styles: square stair steps with a 1px outline, soft round snow blobs and dashed yellow dry-grass borders
steps: seed=12345, stand at tile 107,131 or 121,92 (Highlands) at 1280x720
expected: One edge language across terrains (square 8-bit steps, see EIGHTBIT-STYLE.md)
actual: Snow is drawn as rounded, anti-aliased white blobs, and dry grass has a dashed yellow outline. Every other terrain uses square 32px stair-step edges with a thin dark line. Next to each other, the three styles look like three different art sets.
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/realm-world.js chunk bake (snow / dry_grass edge pass)

title: Daily quest names zones that do not exist in the world: 'Defeat 22 creatures in the Deeps' (the HUD calls zone 2 'Highlands'; zone 1 is 'Meadows' in quests but 'Midlands' in the HUD)
steps: seed=777 (any seed), enter the Nexus, talk to the Quest Giver
Read the kill quest: 'Defeat 22 creatures in the Deeps'
Walk the overworld: the zones are Shore / Midlands / Highlands / Godlands
expected: Quest text uses the same zone names as the HUD, zone toasts and the 'Next goal' line
actual: mm-quests.js has its own list ['Shore','Meadows','Deeps','Godlands']. A new player looks for 'the Deeps' (which sounds like a dungeon) and cannot find it. Progress probably still counts by zone index, but the text is wrong.

title: Nexus plaza camera is not clamped to the plaza: black void bands at the edges when the hero walks to a side or corner
steps: Enter the Nexus at 1280x720
Hold S for 1.5 s, A for 4 s, W for 5 s (to the north-west corner)
Or stand by the Quest Giver (east side)
expected: The camera stops at the plaza border, like the overworld camera does at the map edge
actual: The 640x480 view scrolls past the plaza. A black strip about 35 px wide shows on the top and left in the corner, and on the right and bottom near the Quest Giver or Trial of Six. On a phone the vendor view has a black strip at the bottom. The yellow hero dot sits right against the void.
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/realm-world.js nxCam update (walkable plaza, NX_VW / NX_VH)

title: Phone: the move stick sits on top of the Vendor stall Buy list, and the NPC line spills out of its box
steps: 390x844 touch, enter the Nexus
Walk to the Vendor and tap 'Talk to Vendor'
Look at the Buy list and the 'Vendor: Same goods...' line
expected: The stall can be read and tapped; the stick hides or moves while a stall is open; the NPC line fits its bubble
actual: The 130 px move-stick circle covers the first Buy buttons ('Spark Wand T1 · 20 dust', 'Scout Jerkin T1'). Tapping there drives the stick instead of buying. The vendor line 'Take your time.' overflows the bottom border of its bubble.
suspect: realm-world.js Nexus stall DOM / move stick z-order (mm-pad)

area: Nexus / phone layout (confirms open bugbash item)
title: CONFIRM (already open in bugbash/realm.md): phone Nexus plaza uses only the top ~40% of the screen; portal labels clipped ('dow', 'Bran', 'rittle')
steps: 390x844, walk to the Nexus portal, tap 'Visit the Nexus'
expected: The plaza uses the free height; labels are not cut at the camera edge
actual: The plaza view is about 360x265 px. Below it there is a hint box, then about 230 px of empty space above the stick. Portal labels at the left and right edges are cut off. Still reproduces on tip ae30c26.

title: Escape with an NPC dialog or the quest board open leaves the whole Nexus (and the quest board has no close button)
steps: Desktop, enter the Nexus, walk to the Quest Giver, press E
Press Escape
expected: Escape closes the open board or dialog first; a second Escape leaves the Nexus
actual: The first Escape closes the Nexus and puts you back in the Realm. This was the same for the Quest Giver, Healer, Guide, Oracle, Wanderer and Blacksmith. The quest board panel has no Close or Back button of its own.

title: The Blacksmith says 'Salvage and reforge live in your backpack Forge', then opens the panel titled 'Vendor stall' with the vendor's Buy list
steps: Enter the Nexus, walk to the Blacksmith, press E
expected: The Blacksmith opens a Forge or anvil panel (layout says stall: 'forge'), or at least a panel titled for him
actual: The same 'Vendor stall' panel opens ('Fixed prices in dust. The shelf is the same every day.' plus the Buy list), with a 'Open the Forge' button inside it. The dialogue and the panel contradict each other.

title: Desktop: the daily quest list opens below the fold (about y=690 at 720 px) under the 640x480 plaza; the player has to scroll to see Claim
steps: 1280x720, Nexus, talk to the Quest Giver
expected: The quests and Claim buttons are visible without scrolling (side panel, or the plaza shrinks)
actual: Only the 'Daily quests · date' header peeks out at the bottom edge. The three quests and their Claim buttons are off screen.

title: No key opens the world map (M and Tab do nothing in the overworld, but the dungeon uses M/Tab); the minimap on a fresh island is about 95% black with a tiny reveal patch
steps: Fresh save, Realm world, desktop
Press M, then Tab: nothing happens; you have to click the 96 px minimap
Look at the minimap right after the start
expected: M (as in the dungeon) toggles the big map; the starting area is clearly visible with a readable player dot
actual: M does nothing (the dungeon has M/Tab at dungeon.js:707, realm-world.js has no key). The minimap shows two yellow dots and an 8 px coloured square at the edge where the player is. The big map is only about 200 px wide and mostly black too.

title: Big props are not solid: the hero walks straight through tents, the campfire, towers, ruin pillars, boss altars and trees
steps: seed=12345, stand at tile 44,106 and hold D for 1 s through the camp (tents at 45/47,106)
expected: Large structures block movement (or at least tents, towers, pillars and cabins do), as walls and deep water already do
actual: Only terrain tiles collide (mm-overworld.js props loop never sets solid). The hero passes through every prop, including towers and cabins. Walls, cliffs and deep water block correctly, and I never got stuck. Probably a design choice, but it looks odd.

title: A Lv 1 hero can walk straight into the Godlands (Lethal, rec. Lv 15), with only a toast and a 1 s 0.5x slow; two world bosses sit about 10 tiles apart on the Highlands/Godlands border
steps: Lv 1 save, seed=12345, walk east across the borders at tiles 122,52 / 123,90 / 113,110
expected: Something stronger stops a Lv 1 hero from blundering into Lethal ground (a warning gate or a longer slow), or this is clearly documented as intended
actual: Each first crossing shows 'Highlands: Deadly, recommended Lv 10' or 'Godlands: Lethal, recommended Lv 15' and slows the hero for 1 s, then nothing else happens. At 113,110 'Frost Dragon awakens!' fires right next to the Shadow Hydra site, and both boss bars show. The event ticker also advertises 'Swarm in 0:07 · Godlands' to a brand-new Lv 1 player.

title: In the Nexus the hero is a plain yellow dot, not the chosen class or hero sprite used in the Realm
steps: Enter the Nexus with any hero
expected: The same hero sprite walks the plaza
actual: A 24 px yellow circle with an eye walks around next to detailed NPC sprites (see img/b04-07.jpg, next to the Quest Giver).
